items.job: Replace lower intake manifold gaskets and refill coolant
items.note: Includes coolant and an oil change. Cost rises a lot if coolant got into the oil and damaged the bearings.

items.job: Replace transmission with a remanufactured 4T65E unit
items.note: A used unit costs less. A local rebuild can cost about the same as a reman unit.

items.t: No reverse or slipping in reverse when warm
items.job: Replace reverse servo cover and seals per bulletin
items.note: If the reverse band or drum is already worn, the transmission needs a rebuild, which costs much more.

items.job: Replace second clutch parts per bulletin
items.note: The transmission usually has to come out for this repair.
Price is per door. Many aftermarket regulators come with the motor already attached.

items.t: Oil leaking onto the exhaust manifold can start a fire (recall)
items.job: Replace leaking valve cover gaskets and clean oil residue
items.note: GM recall work is free. Check your VIN or ask a GM dealer first.

items.job: Repair shift cable or park-lock and ignition lock cylinder
items.note: Sometimes only a shifter cable adjustment is needed, which costs much less.

items.t: Ignition switch can turn off while driving (recall)
items.job: Recall key fix; replace ignition switch if worn
items.note: Covered free by GM's ignition key recall. Check your VIN or ask a GM dealer.

items.job: Replace front hub bearing with built-in ABS sensor
items.note: Price is per side. Needs a code scan first; a damaged sensor wire or connector costs less.

items.t: Headlights and daytime lights may stop working (recall)
items.job: Replace headlamp and daytime running light control module
items.note: Recall repair is free at a GM dealer. Check your VIN first.
